icons.label: Home
icons.meaning: Home or top-level destination. Do not substitute for Back.

review.note: Rounded roof (acute join) and CORNER_TOKEN body. 16 px door is narrower and sits lower so the outline still reads as a house.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Search
icons.meaning: Find content. A heavier lens still has an open center.

review.note: Circular lens and capsule handle. The octagon is Angular; Soft must not use it.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Plus
icons.meaning: Add or create. Distinct from expand and zoom-in.

review.note: Two crossing capsules. Round terminals are the Soft tell versus Angular square caps.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Arrow right
icons.meaning: A literal right arrow. Navigation direction must be chosen by the application.

review.note: Round-capped shaft and round-joined chevron. 12 px filled lengthens the head so the tip still reads as direction.
review.usage: The application chooses left/right; artwork does not auto-mirror.

review.note: Circular head and stadium-shouldered body. Angular uses an octagonal head.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: File
icons.meaning: A document. Not a duplicate action.

review.note: Soft-folded page: moderate dog-ear with CORNER_TOKEN on page corners and an outline crease along the fold. Content bar at 24 px only. 12 px filled has no crease (a slit would look like damage); the cut itself is the fold.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

review.note: Rounded body, capsule tabs, one date mark at 12 and two at 16/24. No header slit.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Sliders
icons.meaning: Adjust parameters. Not a funnel filter or gear glyph.

review.note: Circular knobs on stadium rails. Two rows at every native size.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Warning
icons.meaning: A warning requiring a visible text label in every supported appearance and native size.

review.note: Rounded triangle with capsule stem and circular dot. Visible-label restriction is concept-level.

icons.label: Link
icons.meaning: A link or related resource. Not external navigation by itself.

review.note: Two overlapping loops. At 12 px the rings sit on a diagonal so filled weight does not read as a peanut or a horizontal infinity. 16/24 use rotated stadiums. 12 px can still be mistaken for infinity; keep a visible label.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Branch
icons.meaning: A branching relationship. Use a visible label, especially at 12 px.

review.note: Three circular nodes and round-joined connectors. Angular uses square nodes.
review.usage: Keep a visible label, especially at 12 px. This is a usage note, not the Warning restriction record.

icons.label: Star
icons.meaning: Favorite or rating, with context. Distinct from Focus.

review.note: Five-point star with round points and round inner notches. STAR_JOIN is ~0.5× outline (0.65 / 0.85 / 1.0); 1.0×+ join collapses mass. Outer radius is sized so filled 24 mass tracks Angular (~0.27 of canvas) rather than sitting ~30% light.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.
